gates.title: Adaptive paper runtime completes a regular-session broker trial
gates.note: Established 2026-09-23 on a main-built trial: blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/receipt.json broker_readiness passed, trial adaptive-20260923g from a read-only git archive of main 843dc8f (all three #123 engine fixes). 300.5 s at 1x on SIP, 5 real paper orders with 1 cancel-replace and 4 native fills over two 1-share round trips (INTC, GOOGL), 134 crossed quotes dropped, reconciled flat with cash and positions matching, realized -0.28 USD; the read-only broker readback matches (trials/20260923g-main-passed/). Evidence of engine and broker order flow at 1x, not strategy edge. Precondition replaced (dated decision 2026-09-23): the earlier note required Codex's 1e2c96a interrupted-run reporting on main before a flip; that is replaced by direct checks on paper-output.json (elapsed 300.48 s of 300; 147 decision events spanning 299.04 s with a largest gap of 2.11 s; independent review of #128 reproduced both). Overturn: a main trial that includes f75a3d2's interrupted-run reporting and flags this build's behaviour as interrupted. History before this flip: Receipt then: status local_integration_passed_new_broker_trial_pending, broker_readiness not_started (regular_session_window_unavailable). Synthetic capacity fixture (180 fills / 90 round trips in 60.42 s) used zero broker connections and is not this gate. Authorized paper work, not run by the 2026-09-22 handbook wave. 2026-09-22 10:55 ET: one SIP trial in the default state root ended completed_no_signals in 0.35 s with 0 orders and a flat reconciliation, which does not meet the flip condition. Root cause measured: the Windows host clock was +0.64 s off NTP and WSL's hv_utils time sync pulled the guest to it, so live quotes looked future-stamped and tripped the transport's -0.25 s quote guard (quote_timestamp_stale -> start_not_ready); an environment fault, not an engine or feed fault. Next attempt needs `w32tm /resync /force` on the host (user OS action) and, since PR-4, a passing promotion-gate result for the paper command (--gate-result/--snapshot). Ownership passed to peer:sota-workflow-resolution with adaptive-paper integration on 2026-09-22. 2026-09-23 (engine outputs and labelled operator observations in blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/trials/20260923-interrupted/): the scheduled 10:05 ET timer for frozen 41d39b3 was stopped externally at 09:39:24 ET (actor unidentified); relaunched at 10:11:05 ET from the same frozen archive. Ingest 480 rows and the promotion gate passed, but the runner stopped after 4.15 s of 300 (3 warm-up decisions, regime unavailable, 8,512 native quotes, 0 orders, flat) and reported completed_no_signals. The log shows a trading-stream websocket restart message; corrected at 11:30 ET: that message is emitted when the engine closes its own streams at shutdown, not the cause (the transport alone stayed healthy for 25 s). A clock-offset check about 13 minutes later found 0.06 s against NTP (operator observation), so the 2026-09-22 clock fault is unlikely. An interrupted decision loop is needs_attention, not a trial; no retry of 41d39b3. 2026-09-23 11:27 ET second attempt (blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/trials/20260923b-needs-attention/): from Codex's frozen stop-diagnostics build 1e2c96a, needs_attention after 25.9 s. Recorded: decision_exit transport_gap, callback_failure at stage quote_normalization (normalize_quote raised TransportError). Most likely a crossed SIP quote (bid above ask), the only rejection class in the committed quote-validity measurements; for the 10:11 run it is only a possible explanation (the retained crossed-quote rates vary widely by minute, from 0 to 36 per 60 s window, so the chance of one among its 8,512 quotes ranges from about 15 percent to near certainty; that build recorded no stop reason). 11:42 and 11:5x ET runs from integration build 796e3d1 (1e2c96a plus the crossed-quote fix; trials/20260923c-reconcile-refusal/) reached the 30 s reconciliation and failed there: transport.mark_reconciled refused while any event was queued, and on SIP the quote queue is never empty (traceback retained). Fixed by dropping and counting well-formed crossed or one-sided quotes (halt-flagged, malformed or unsubscribed ones still fail closed) and refusing reconciliation only while an order event is queued. Gate unchanged until a trial completes. 11:54 ET run from integration build 885663a (both SIP fixes; trials/20260923e-first-roundtrip/): the first real engine round trip on the paper broker, INTC buy 1 filled 120.40 then recovery sell 1 filled 120.39, flat, net -0.01 USD; it stopped at 43.3 s with adapter_error because the fill TradeId (UUID + ':cum:' + qty, 42 characters) exceeds Nautilus's 36-character limit. Fixed with a deterministic 36-character digest. 11:59 ET: first PASSED 1x trial (trials/20260923f-first-passed/) from integration build 5e1d512 (1e2c96a plus all three #123 fixes): 300.1 s, duration_completed, 8 real paper orders and 8 native fills over four 1-share round trips (GOOGL, AAPL, AMZN, INTC), 13 crossed quotes dropped, reconciled flat with cash and positions matching, realized -0.29 USD; the broker readback matches. The gate stays not_established until 1e2c96a's commits and #123 are on main and a main-built trial passes, so the flip receipt binds to published code. Regular session only (2026-09-23, status unchanged): extended hours are not qualified. The first extended-hours paper run (trials/20260923-post-extended-hours, 19:01 ET, the same risk limits except max_held_symbols 4 for a 4-symbol universe) stopped after 10.9 s with 0 orders, flat and reconciled; a data-timeout reconnect was logged but the stop reason is not recorded. The 3 s quote-age cap and the benchmark-freshness preflight are in code, and a retained 19:20 ET SIP sample had all four benchmarks fresh at once in 3 of 8 snapshots; the remedy is an open design question for a limits decision.
